name: Gettysburg
summary: The battlefield where the Civil War turned and Lincoln spoke — one of the most moving historical landscapes in America.

lodging.name: A historic Gettysburg inn
lodging.blurb: Some inns date to the battle itself.

foodMustTry.name: Tavern fare in the historic square

days.label: Day 115 — The Battlefield
days.summary: Three days of 1863, told across the fields.

item.title: Museum & the Gettysburg Cyclorama
item.blurb: Start here — the film, the 1884 cyclorama painting of Pickett's Charge, and the museum before you take the field.

item.title: Battlefield auto tour with a guide
item.blurb: Hire a licensed battlefield guide to ride your car through the 3-day battle — the best way to grasp what happened here.

days.label: Day 116 — Little Round Top & the Address
days.summary: The famous ground and the cemetery where Lincoln spoke.

item.title: Little Round Top & Devil's Den
item.blurb: Walk the boulders of Devil's Den and the hill Chamberlain's men held on the second day.

item.title: Soldiers' National Cemetery
item.blurb: Where Lincoln delivered the Gettysburg Address in 1863 — quiet rows of Union graves.

rest.label: Time to sit with it
rest.note: You have just walked Little Round Top and stood where the Address was given, and the months ahead hold a great deal more of this. Nothing goes after it. The fields stay open until dark and are best walked slowly, and alone.

commute.scenicNote: Southeast across the Mason-Dixon line into the du Pont country of Delaware.
